title: Keep issued invoices from changing during the billing run

blocks.text: The monthly billing run sets up one `Invoice.Builder` per plan, with the plan's fixed lines, and builds each customer's invoice from a copy of it, adding that customer's own lines. Support has two complaints: one customer's overage line showed up on the next customer's invoice, and an invoice already sent as a PDF read differently when it was opened again in the portal.

items: `keep(...)`: the lines an invoice holds on to when it is built;
`Builder.copy()`: a builder with the same customer and lines, filled in further on its own.

blocks.text: An issued invoice must read the same whatever is done afterwards to its builder, to another copy, or to the list its `lines()` returns. About five lines in total.

cases.says: an invoice keeps its customer and its lines in the order they were added
an invoice built from a copy of a plan's builder has the plan's lines followed by its own
a line added to a builder after build() does not appear on the invoice already built
writing to the list an invoice's lines() returns leaves the invoice as issued
a line added to one copy of a plan's builder reaches neither the plan nor the next copy

origin.section: A Builder Used Again After build() Changes What It Built, Unless the Product Copies

concepts: A product that keeps the builder's list, or an unmodifiable view of it, changes when the builder is used again; List.copyOf in the product fixes it.
A builder reused after build() keeps every part it was given, so each use of a template starts from its own copy of the builder.
